steps.name: gcr.io/cloud-builders/git@sha256:8cae9507238f715abbefb6d9e13826340b8f265312fdae5b99e699fe1289a02c
args:
expected="$${1}"
if [[ $${#expected} -ne 40 || ! $${expected} =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "COMMIT_SHA must be a full lowercase 40-character revision" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! actual=$$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD 2>/dev/null); then
  echo "Git source metadata is required" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ $${actual} != "$${expected}" ]]; then
  echo "Cloud Build source revision does not match COMMIT_SHA" >&2
  exit 1
fi
materializer_path=service/materialize-reviewed-agent-beacon-source.sh
if ! materializer_object=$$(git rev-parse --verify "$${actual}:$${materializer_path}" 2>/dev/null); then
  echo "Reviewed source materializer is required" >&2
  exit 1
fi
temporary_materializer=$$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$${temporary_materializer}"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
if ! git cat-file blob "$${materializer_object}" >"$${temporary_materializer}"; then
  echo "Unable to load reviewed source materializer" >&2
  exit 1
fi
/bin/bash "$${temporary_materializer}" "$${expected}"
